svg.aria-label: Three questions Malta decides in three different ways
svg.text: Three questions Malta decides in three different ways
Whether you may live in Malta
This is what the MPRP certificate answers
The certificate has no bearing on it
More than 183 days in a year
Worldwide income, or only what is remitted
The MPRP certificate answers only the first. The other two are decided without it.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 1 September 2026
